name: Freepik AI
summary: Freepik's AI creative suite: images, video, editing and upscaling.
description: Freepik bundles AI tools into its stock platform: a multi-model image generator, video, editing, upscaling, sketch-to-image and consistent characters. A subscription covers stock assets and generation credits.

summary_fr: Suite de création IA de Freepik : images, vidéos, retouche et agrandissement.
